turns.question: By what percentage did revenue in the week starting Monday 14 September 2026 grow over the week before?
turns.answer: Revenue in the week starting Monday 14 September 2026 (14 to 20 September 2026) grew 32.7% over the week before (revenue week-over-week growth, 0.3265 as a share). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
